description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 29.08.2016 to 04.09.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns regulatory matters under the Customs Ordinance. It announces new legally-binding rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges, rescinds previous rates, and establishes a regulatory framework for customs payments. The content focuses on legal/regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
